note: Review: desk item about Nov 5 strike rewritten with named outlets and specifics

ops.find: France prepares for a nationwide strike and convergence of protests on November 5.

event.label: reported
event.text: France: unions, high-school and university students and the Gilets jaunes coordination are all calling people into the streets on November 5, with more than 250 demonstrations planned nationwide, Libération reports. Ouest-France and ici report school blockades, a march in Lorient and reduced SNCF services, including one TER in two in Dordogne.
